name: Whistleblower
source: PFS Guide to Organized Play 6.0 pg. 16
body:
Drawbacks
Whistleblower
Source PFS Guide to Organized Play 6.0 pg. 16
Category Faction
You are wise to the schemes of liars, thieves, and cheats, granting you a +1 bonus on Sense Motive checks, and that skill becomes a class skill for you.
